title: Cross-engine attribute-based access controls (ABAC) is now generally available
body:
Cross-engine attribute-based access controls (ABAC) is now generally available. Supported external engines can read Unity Catalog managed tables with ABAC policies, row filters, and column masks enforced by Databricks serverless compute.

See [Cross-engine attribute-based access controls (ABAC)](/aws/en/external-access/cross-engine-abac) for requirements, supported clients, and serverless compute costs.
